source_metadata.title: REWARD—an open-source framework for identifying the unknown benefits of existing medications to inform drug discovery, development, and repurposing
source_metadata.journal: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association
source_metadata.source_type: methods/software framework article with applied system-scale results and summaries of prior REWARD analyses

extraction_limitations: The current article is primarily a methods/software-framework paper. Published examples 1-3 summarize previously published REWARD analyses; those atoms are tagged reported_prior_REWARD_example and should not be treated as newly generated primary results of this manuscript.

Figure 4 contains an internal labeling inconsistency: the right-hand diagram specifies a ≥1000-patient threshold, while the printed caption repeats >100 for the right-hand branch. Calculated Figure 4 atoms follow the diagram labels and flag the figure as their source.

The manuscript expands the REWARD acronym inconsistently across locations (including “REal-World Evidence and Research of Drug performance,” “REal-World Assessment and Research of Drugs,” and “REal-World Evidence and Research of Drug”). No normalization of the acronym expansion was imposed on atom content.

Figure 5(c) dashboard values were extracted from the rendered figure because the detailed numeric table is not fully represented in surrounding narrative text. Those atoms remain review_status=needs_review.

No external verification or re-analysis of claims-database results was performed. Atoms preserve source-reported claims, explicit calculations from reported counts, and source limitations without upgrading observational signals to causal findings.
